title: finding(plugin-detail): eleven more `Intl` call sites across nine files format in the MACHINE locale — the same `useDisplayLocale` sentence objectui#9453 enforced on the summary chip, and nothing enumerates the class
body:
Found by the `os-dev` lane implementing objectui#9453 under an explicit no-sweep fence, and re-measured by the reviewing seat with its own instrument. ⛔ Reported rather than swept, which is what the fence required.

## What

`useDisplayLocale` (`packages/i18n/src/useDisplayLocale.ts`) states in its own doc comment the one thing a caller must not do:

> The one thing a caller must not do is reach past this hook for the raw tenant locale and hand `Intl` the `undefined` it gets on an unconfigured workspace — `undefined` means "the MACHINE's locale", which is neither channel. Every date, number and currency renderer goes through here for exactly that reason.

objectui#9453 put the `summaryFields` chip's currency and date branches onto the display locale. **The same package carries eleven more call sites that do the thing the sentence names**, across nine files.

## Measured — census by the reviewing seat, independent of the reporting lane

Instrument: `toLocaleDateString()` / `toLocaleString()` / `toLocaleTimeString()` with **no** argument, plus `Intl.*Format(undefined`, over `packages/plugin-detail/src`, excluding `__tests__`. Read on `c1006ed8e`:

| file | sites |
|---|---|
| `PointInTimeRestore.tsx` | 3 (2 × `toLocaleString()`, 1 × `toLocaleDateString()`) |
| `RecordMetaFooter.tsx` | 1 — `Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, …)` |
| `ActivityTimeline.tsx` | 1 |
| `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` | 1 |
| `RecordComments.tsx` | 1 |
| `ThreadedReplies.tsx` | 1 |
| `HistoryTimeline.tsx` | 1 |
| `ConcurrentUpdateDialog.tsx` | 1 |
| `DiffView.tsx` | 1 |

**11 sites, 9 files.** ⭐ The instrument's lit control is `DetailView.tsx` itself: the same probe returns its 2 `Intl.NumberFormat(undefined` sites on `main` today — the ones PR objectui#9777 is repairing — so a `0` from this grep would have meant a broken query and it does not return one.

## Why the count is a floor and not the population

⚠️ `toLocaleDateString()` with **no argument at all** is what this probe catches. A site passing a variable that happens to be `undefined` at runtime, or passing an options bag with a `undefined` first argument spelled differently, is **not** in this count. ⇒ treat 11 as a lower bound, and re-derive before anyone prices a sweep.

## Harm, and why it is the same class rather than the same card

Identical to objectui#9453's: a German tenant reads one stored timestamp one way in a list and another beside the record it opens, and on an unconfigured workspace the surface agrees with whatever locale the machine has. ⚠️ **But these are timeline / history / diff surfaces, not the KPI chip**, and objectui#9453's own open question — whether a compact face survives the move — does not obviously transfer to them. ⛔ So this is not "objectui#9453 again, nine times": each surface owes a reading of what its current face is before its options bag is touched.

⭐ The class has been closed four times already on other surfaces — objectui#4541, objectui#4553, objectui#4566, objectui#4576 — and each time on the file surface of whatever card was in flight. That is precisely why the population keeps reappearing: nothing enumerates it.

## Shape of the remedy — ⛔ not decided here

The mechanical part is one hook call and eleven argument edits. The question this card asks instead is whether a **gate** should exist: a lint rule or a check script that refuses a bare `toLocale*()` / `Intl.*Format(undefined` in a package that depends on `@object-ui/i18n`. Without one, the fifth closure of this class will be followed by a sixth. ⛔ Whether that gate is affordable — and what its exemption list has to carry — is a devx question this card does not answer.

## Not measured

⛔ Whether any of the 11 sites is deliberately machine-locale (a debug surface, a copy-to-clipboard payload); no site was read for intent. ⛔ Whether the same class exists in sibling packages; only `packages/plugin-detail` was enumerated. ⛔ Whether `displayLocale` is in scope at each site, which is what decides whether the repair is one line or a hook addition per file.

Refs: objectui#9453 / PR objectui#9777 (the card whose fence produced this census) · objectui#4541, objectui#4553, objectui#4566, objectui#4576 (four prior closures of this class on other surfaces) · `packages/i18n/src/useDisplayLocale.ts` (the contract sentence).

---

os-decision-facets

## 维护者速读

「把用户看得见的时间按**机器的** locale 格式化」这一类缺陷,本仓已经**关掉过五次、又重现过五次**。PR objectui#9905 关掉了第十个站点——而那个站点**任何 grep 都看不见**(它是一个没人传的可选参数,缺陷写在它自己的文档注释里:「Defaults to browser locale」)。这一次的修法是把参数改成**必填**,于是那个 `undefined` 在类型上**不可表示**了。

**问:要不要给这一类加一条仓库级门禁(A),还是继续逐处修(B)?**

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户能感知到什么 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A 加门禁** | CI 扫出「用机器 locale 格式化用户可见时间」的写法并**响亮拒绝** | 这一类不再回归;⚠️ 代价是一条永久要维护的门禁,以及它的假阳性会挡住无关 PR |
| **B 继续逐处修** | 发现一处修一处 | 今天什么都不变;按已发生的五次闭合—重现,**它会再来** |

## 四棱

- **① 项目长远合理性**:A 把**一类**缺陷关死,缩小复发面;B 让同一类反复消耗席位。⚠️ 但每条门禁本身也是永久义务,且本类**一半的站点门禁看不见**(第十个就是靠类型必填解决的)。按①:A,且门禁只认领它能看见的那半。
- **② 实际业务拉动**:⭐ **有,而且是量出来的**——五次闭合五次重现,最近一次是本卡。用户可感知的后果是**日期/时间显示成另一个国家的写法**,在多语言部署里是可见错误。
- **③ 防 AI 犯错**:这一类几乎全是「改代码时顺手写回去」的复发;**响亮拒绝(CI 红)**优于静默容忍,门禁正是③要的形状。
- **④ 创业阶段不扩散**:新增**必需**门禁属于人工地板(⛔ 执行席不得自裁),这是本卡在决策箱的原因;可先 report-only 一轮再转必需,⛔ 不一步到位。

⛔ **The `Prior rulings read:` line published here earlier was run in the WRONG REPO's checkout, and this seat is correcting it in place.** (Corrected at 2026-09-18T20:35Z, clock read by this write.) `check-prior-rulings.mjs` has no `--repo` flag by design — its own docblock says 「the CORPUS is always THIS checkout … so a flag naming a different board would read a card from one repo and answer it out of another repo's rulings, **with nothing in the output saying so**」 — and this seat ran it from the objectstack checkout and pasted the answer onto an objectui card. Measured: objectui's `docs/adr/` holds **0001, 0034, 0036, 0053–0059** only; **ADR-0021, ADR-0029 and ADR-0061 do not exist in this repo** (they do in objectstack, control run in the same command). Both readings, labelled:

- **Prior rulings read (THIS repo, objectui — `AGENTS.md` + `docs/adr/**`)**: `locale` / `intl` / `timestamp` → **1 hit**, in `AGENTS.md`; no ADR in this repo names them.
- **Prior rulings read (objectstack's corpus — the shared protocol's rulings, relevant where this card touches the contract, ⛔ NOT this repo's numbering)**: locale,intl,timestamp,gate → 46 hits; ADR-0060 D6, ADR-0061 D2, ADR-0061 D5, ADR-0062 D2, ADR-0062 D5, ADR-0066 D3, ADR-0067 D4, ADR-0068 D1, ADR-0068 D4

**推荐:A**(加门禁,先 report-only 一轮,零假阳性后再转必需),回退项 **B**。自检:「只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:**否**——②③ 同向;④ 只要求它分两步落地,⛔ 不改字母。」

**置信缺口**:门禁能覆盖的是 **grep 可见**的那部分写法。本卡最贵的那个站点(可选参数没人传)⛔ **不在门禁的射程内**——它是类型改造解决的。⇒ 裁 A ⛔ 不等于这一类从此不可能发生,而是它不可能再以**同一种拼法**发生。姊妹包的同类站点已另立 objectui#9909。

**裁后执行**:裁 A ⇒ 一张 `domain:ui` 卡写门禁(report-only)+ 一张后续卡转必需并把 required 集同笔更新;裁 B ⇒ 本卡关闭,objectui#9909 照常按单卡处理。

<sub>四棱块由 `domain:ui#2` 执行席在本卡进决策箱时补齐(2026-09-18T18:36Z);⛔ 本席不改级别、不改路由,⛔ 也不代裁。落地记录见评论 `5732403857`。</sub>
